<thought>The spectrum shows a strong M+2 peak at ~33% of the base peak, which matches the characteristic chlorine isotopic pattern (35Cl/37Cl ≈ 3:1). No equal M+2 peak (bromine) or ~4% M+2 (sulfur) is observed. Therefore chlorine is the only element that can be definitively identified from the isotope distribution.</thought>
<final_answer>['Cl']</final_answer>
